shipLog.text: ◆ Docking at station! Your docking fee includes FREE access to the docking fee! Additional services are also fees! CHIP loves an itemized life!
◆ Planting registered! Your crop's warranty begins NOW and covers nothing! Nature has never accepted liability!
NOW ARRIVING: Nebula 1! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 9 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Paperwork: “Sign everything without reading”! BOLD leadership!
You signed. RESULTS: +5 MORALE, 1 DAY! ★★★★★
◆ Entering the nebula! Signal loss imminent! CHIP will be unable to serve you ads for the duration! CHIP has pre-loaded several hundred!
NOW ARRIVING: The Layover (Est. Accidentally)! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE…
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at A Word, Captain: “PRIORITY DOSE, QUIET ONE”! BOLD leadership!
Dr. RESULTS: DR. TANAKA +4 MORALE, 1 DAY! ★★★★★
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Market Row: “BACK TO DOCK”! BOLD leadership!
RESULTS: 1 DAY! ★★★★★
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Station Inbound: “LEAVE STATION”! BOLD leadership!
RESULTS: nothing aboard changed! ★★★★★
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Station arrival! CHIP has already forwarded your purchase history to every vendor on the concourse! They are VERY excited to meet you!
NOW ARRIVING: The Belated Concern! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 9 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ CHIP files a reference next to the Provident's registry entry: ships built to carry whole generations are a real, seriously-studied idea.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Other Colony Ship: “Hail them — friendly, mostly”! BOLD leadership!
You open a channel and spend an hour trading route notes, complaints… RESULTS: +3 MORALE, 1 DAY! ★★★★★
◆ Thanks for accepting our Terms without reading them! Most people do, and our Legal team adores every one of them!
GROWBAY UPDATE: Soybean hit VEGETATIVE! 27% grown, health 96. INVEST!
NOW ARRIVING: Nebula 4! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ The soybeans haven't needed anyone in days. The crew has started holding them up as an example.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at They're Inside: “HIDE”! BOLD leadership!
They pass through your ship looking for someone who isn't there, and… RESULTS: +2 MORALE, 2 DAYS! ★★★★★
◆ A nebula! Pure hydrogen, unbranded, unclaimed! CHIP's sponsors are calling it 'a waste of perfectly good gas!'
NOW ARRIVING: Route Decision! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 9 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Right of Way: “Starboard lane — the port beacon has a shifty look”! BOLD leadership!
You go starboard. RESULTS: 1 DAY! ★★★★★
◆ Thanks for departing with us! Your launch was brought to you by the Terms and Conditions, which remain in force!
NOW ARRIVING: Planet McPlanetface! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Soil Sample Paradise: “Survey for water sources”! BOLD leadership!
Subsurface ice detected and extracted. RESULTS: +10 H2O, 2 DAYS! ★★★★★
◆ Planet ahead! CHIP's real estate partners describe it as 'a fixer-upper with views!' The views are of more planet!
GROWBAY UPDATE: Soybean hit FLOWERING! 58% grown, health 100. INVEST!
NOW ARRIVING: Asteroid Field (beta)! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ The ship computer notes that real interstellar messages face the same math: past a certain distance, every conversation becomes a letter.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Last Radio Hour: “Open the channel to everyone — one hour, all hands”! BOLD leadership!
For one hour the ship is a phone booth. RESULTS: +8 MORALE, 1 DAY! ★★★★★
